targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-744 (INV-088 world/goal-evaluator DV-coupling) is a VALID, non-degenerate test (all 3 preconditions met) that FAILed as an UNDER-POWERED NEAR-MISS, not a refutation. The load-bearing non-tautological criterion C3 (immature-anchor evaluator noise-fitted below chance, R2<=0.05) PASSED cleanly on all 3 seeds; the mean by-onset harm_eval R2_test is textbook-monotone (-0.029 -> +0.203) and mean delta 0.232 clears the 0.15 floor. The FAIL is confined to the two cross-seed ROBUSTNESS gates (C1 effect-size mean>=2*SD; C2 monotone rho>=0.80), BOTH broken by a single outlier seed (seed 7: largest endpoint delta 0.421 but non-monotone rho 0.2) at n=3, while seeds 42/19 are clean (rho 0.9/1.0). Adjudicated 2026-07-12 (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-744_2026-07-12): DO NOT count as weakening INV-088. Reclassified evidence_direction weakens -> inconclusive (non-counting). This is INV-088's only DV evidence (the IV half is the SUPPORTED 740a leg), so reclassification hides no remaining negative -- no illusory conflict resolution. Pending higher-seed retest V3-EXQ-744a (8 seeds, same design + criteria) to resolve whether seed 7 is an unlucky tail (gates pass) or the coupling is genuinely seed-fragile (a real, weaker finding).

learning_extracted: INV-088 DV-coupling shows a clean directional signal on the V3 substrate: the z_world-reading harm evaluator is noise-fitted below chance at immaturity and climbs to held-out R2 0.20 at maturity, tracking the rising z_world differentiation gradient -- the DV half of the world/goal leg, complementing 740a's validated IV half.

A 2*SD effect-size robustness gate combined with rho>=0.80 monotonicity is stringent at n=3: a single outlier seed can break BOTH gates while the mean trajectory is clearly monotone. This is a power/robustness limitation of the seed count, not a substrate ceiling or a claim falsification.

The correct adjudication of a valid-but-underpowered near-miss is evidence_direction=inconclusive (non-counting) + higher-seed retest -- NOT weakens. Recording it as weakens would let one noisy seed manufacture spurious counter-evidence against a directionally-supported claim.

Recording-core gap (top-level config/substrate_hash/etc. absent, present only per-arm) did not block this adjudication because arm_fingerprints carried substrate identity; still worth closing via stamp_recording_core in 744a.
